# Enterbird AI Digital

> Enterbird is an AI-powered e-commerce and digital growth agency in Istanbul, Turkey. It builds and grows online stores: Shopify and e-commerce infrastructure, performance marketing (Google Ads, Meta Ads), SEO and GEO, marketplace management (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon), e-export, US company formation, operations and logistics, AI automation, brand and design. The site is available in Turkish (/tr) and English (/en).

## Free tool

- [Ücretsiz Site Analizi (free e-commerce website audit)](https://enterbird.com/tr/site-analizi): Free online tool, no sign-up. Enter a store URL and get a 0–100 score in about a minute: Google PageSpeed mobile speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, TBT, CLS); site errors (broken links and images, SSL certificate expiry, http→https and www redirects, soft 404, insecure http assets, console errors); Google visibility (title, meta description, structured data, sitemap, robots.txt, canonical, noindex, accessibility); ad tracking (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta pixel); trust and legal pages (returns, privacy/KVKK, distance-selling terms, contact, WhatsApp, payment badges); and a product page check (Product schema price/availability/rating, add-to-cart button, reviews, image count).
- [Free Website Audit (English)](https://enterbird.com/en/site-analizi): Same tool in English.
